pairs: Best way to defrost a refrigerator freezer?

The best way to defrost a refrigerator freezer is to first remove all the food and place it in a cooler with ice. Then, turn off the power to the refrigerator and open the door to allow the cold air to escape. This can take several hours. Once the freezer is completely defrosted, you can clean it out and dry it thoroughly before putting the food back in.
